correctness.rationale: Any lift of the special-fiber map is x a + εv. Its defining-relation defect divided by ε is x^r a^r(a^(n−r)−1) + n x^(n−1) a_0^(n−1)v(0) in the special fiber. The correction has image exactly the top-degree line in tame characteristic and image zero when p divides n. Thus the exponents ℓ and the q^(n−1) and q^n fiber counts follow, including the vacuous tame ℓ=0 case. A homomorphism lifting an automorphism is invertible by the determinant criterion over the local coefficient ring. If z=a/a_0−1 has first nonzero degree s, then (1+z)^m−1 has first nonzero degree s p^ν: Frobenius multiplies the order by p^ν and the prime-to-p exponent preserves it. Counting the permitted coefficients and the d roots for a_0 gives the stated image size over every finite field, including r=0. The supplied verifier was inspected, not executed; its F4 loop checks existence/image counts rather than independently counting every lift fiber. The algebra proves both.
